subject: Ignite Satellite — promo codes for meetup (last-minute top-up)
messages:
From: Olivia Reed <olivia@igniteconf.org>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Ignite Satellite — promo codes for meetup

Hi David,

Quick one — we just had a surge of walk-up registrants for the San Jose satellite session on Aug 14 and are short on promotional passes. Can Redwood do a one-time top-up of 150 trial credits for the local meetup? These would be distributed as single-use promo codes for attendees (small group, ~120 expected but could tick up).

We have the co-marketing agreement in place (signed). Need the codes by EOD tomorrow so the local team can include them in the check-in packet and the post-event follow-up.

Attached is the event flyer and the rough audience profile. Let me know if you need an attendee list or a billing code.

Thanks,
Olivia Reed
Events Manager | IgniteConf
olivia@igniteconf.org
Attachment: satellite_flyer.pdf (application/pdf)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Reed <olivia@igniteconf.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Satellite — promo codes for meetup

Hi Olivia — looping in Marissa (partner ops) and Karthik (growth) to approve allocation. Two quick clarifying Qs so we size this correctly:

- Do you want 150 single-use promo codes or a smaller number with per-attendee top-ups (e.g., up to 3k tokens each)?
- Can you share the attendee list or at least an expected redemption window (we typically set a 90-day expiry by default; we can shorten if you need it tied to the event).

If you can reply with those details I’ll push for a same-day fulfilment.

Thanks,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Olivia Reed <olivia@igniteconf.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Satellite — promo codes for meetup

Hi all — OK to approve a one-time top-up of 150 promo codes from the Community Promo Pool for this satellite session. Please observe the following terms: 

- Cap redemptions at 3,000 tokens per attendee.
- Codes expire 90 days after issue unless Olivia confirms event-tied expiry.
- Billing will be routed to marketing budget code MKT-IGNITE-23; accounting will need an allocation note for the month of Aug.

I’ve attached the standard allocation terms for partner promo pulls. David, please ensure the final codes CSV includes: code, expiry, token_limit, and a short note field for HubSpot tagging.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Olivia Reed <olivia@igniteconf.org>
Date: 2027-08-07T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Ignite Satellite — promo codes for meetup

Thanks Marissa — a couple operational asks from growth: 

- Please namespace the codes with IGNITE-SJ- to make tracking easier.
- Include a tracking link with UTM params for the post-event survey (we want to attribute any trial-to-paid conversions).
- HubSpot tag: partner:ignite_2027_satellite; please send the HubSpot record ID when codes are live.

Also, Olivia — can you confirm whether you want codes usable only on the hosted API (recommended) or also on Dedicated instances? If Dedicated, we’ll need a short technical allowance in the allocation note.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

All set — attaching the CSV with 150 single-use codes and the provisional invoice proposal for marketing. Summary below: 

- Promo namespace: IGNITE-SJ-
- 150 single-use codes, 3,000 token cap, expiry 2027-11-05 (90 days from issue)
- Billing: MKT-IGNITE-23 (see invoice_proposal.xlsx)
- Tracking: all codes include UTM params utm_source=igniteconf&utm_campaign=ignite_satellite_2027 and HubSpot record HS-Record-789412

Olivia — the codes CSV is attached (ignite_satellite_codes.csv). Please confirm you received and that ops will use the IGNITE-SJ- namespace at check-in. If you want an event-tied expiry instead, say the date and I’ll regenerate codes.

Thanks everyone — I’ll mark this allocation in the partner portal once Olivia confirms receipt.

-David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
